content:
**Tasty Radscorpion Egg Omelette** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

It is an omelette made from the egg of a radscorpion that has been peppered. It also cures all addictions when consumed.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Pepper (2) Radscorpion Egg (2) Tato (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Tasty Radscorpion Egg Omelette | | Tasty Radscorpion Egg Omelette (1) | 

Despite *Fallout 76*'s publication in the United States, the spelling used in the game, "omelette," is the spelling used in British English. "Omelet" is the spelling used in American English. [1]
